name: io.github.zhaoxinghua09-cell/medxpert-library-connector
title: MedXpert 图书馆连接器（通用版）
description: Local RAG MCP server for your own .md knowledge base: BM25 + local Ollama, offline, zero egress.

environmentVariables.name: LIBRARY_WIKI_DIR
environmentVariables.description: Directory of your own .md files. Defaults to the sample wiki bundled in the package.

environmentVariables.name: OLLAMA_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Local Ollama endpoint used for embeddings and generation (default http://127.0.0.1:11434).

io.modelcontextprotocol.registry/publish.prerequisite: Ollama running locally with an embedding model pulled (e.g. ollama pull bge-m3).
io.modelcontextprotocol.registry/publish.scope_note: Retrieval runs over the user's own documents; the bundled sample wiki is three pages and contains no proprietary data.
